request.style: English, female jazz vocal with warm timbre, brushed drums, upright bass, acoustic guitar, muted trumpet, saxophone, smooth and soulful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I enter your house through abundant mercy
Bow in reverence to your holy place
Lead me in your righteousness, O Lord
Make your way straight before my face

[Chorus]
Let all who take refuge in you rejoice
Let them sing for joy forevermore
Spread your shelter over them completely
Let those who love your name exult

[Verse]
Declare them guilty, God, in your judgment
Let them fall by their own wicked schemes
Drive them out for their many transgressions
For they have rebelled against your name

[Chorus]
Let all who take refuge in you rejoice
Let them sing for joy forevermore
Spread your shelter over them completely
Let those who love your name exult

[Bridge]
There is nothing trustworthy in their mouth
Within them lies a path of destruction
Their throat is an open grave to all
With their tongues they flatter in vain

[Chorus]
Let all who take refuge in you rejoice
Let them sing for joy forevermore
Spread your shelter over them completely
Let those who love your name exult

[Outro]
You bless the righteous with favor
Surround them with a shield of grace
